summary: Answered the owner's three notes on Disaster Desk's Hyatt walkway long video: disaster scenes now show the people (a 3D crowd and rescuers, no gore) and long videos speak 1.25x faster; the hook note went to Studio. Studio's long topic list now includes the research feed's long topics (Disaster Desk 17, Craze & Crash 14, up from 1). Wrote the Sunday weekly summaries.
why: Owner notes come first (three open on L-20261121-42, one handed to me by the auditor). Studio had one long topic per new channel while research held 13-18. Paisa Panchayat's cycle 2 is on day 1 of 7 with no data, so its loop waits.

findings.title: Paisa Panchayat: last week's Shorts had a median of 389 views in 48 h, 90.3% average viewed and 38.7% stayed to watch (n 7)
findings.detail: Up from 207 views and 33.8% stayed the week before (n 17); the 14-day stayed to watch is 37.9%, still under the 45% floor. Best: the Disneyland ticket Short (950 views, 98.7% viewed). Cycle 2 promise-stays-in-hook-place has 0 of 8 Shorts a side with data, verdict by 28 Nov. Long tests quiet-bed 1 of 4 and chart-gap-fill 2 of 4 a side.

findings.title: Disaster Desk's walkway video showed nobody
findings.detail: Its crowd, tape, toll and recap beats spoke of 1,600 people and 114 deaths over lit chairs, a viewfinder and fallen walkways. The 3D kit's own README said 'parts only, never people'. The new lint check flags 5 beats in it, and 1-2 in each of 3 other disaster videos.

findings.title: Long topic feed gap on the new channels
findings.detail: state --format long read only longform/topics.json (1 topic each), while research/topics.json held 18 (Disaster Desk) and 13 (Craze & Crash) sourced long topics.

findings.title: Other channels
findings.detail: Geography 4 Shorts with 48 h data (59.8% viewed), tech 2, the rest 0: no challengers started. Every channel's upload queue was empty tonight (config/channels.json health red), which is the video runs' problem, not a test's. Going Down's 'the dive kit has no pieces' QA failure (2 Shorts) is covered by the owner's 22 Nov rule that kit channels add pieces during the video run.

findings.title: Shape promoted
findings.detail: Paisa Panchayat hidden-payer: trial -> active (3 Shorts, 70.7% viewed vs the 53.5% median).
